name: Adelaide University Aboriginal Student Scholarship
summary: Up to $6,000 a year for up to four years for commencing Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander students facing financial barriers.
key: Total value $36,000, including an annual stipend of up to $6,000 per annum for up to 4 years.
who: Commencing undergraduate or postgraduate coursework students (including AU Online)
An Australian Citizen of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent
Demonstrate financial barriers to access post-secondary study
catches: The latest listed round opened 27 July 2026 and closed 23 August 2026
Also includes a $1,500 relocation grant for students moving from outside Major Cities and a $500 starter pack
